text: Which boutique law firms in Brisbane Northside (Chermside & North Lakes) offer free initial consultations, fixed-fee wills, or deferred-fee options for family law and wills and estates?

sections.text:
Several Brisbane northside boutique or specialist firms advertise one or more of the requested pricing options:

| Firm | Location | Relevant offer |
|---|---|---|
| **Northside Family Law Centre** | Chermside and Sandgate | Free telephone meeting; the firm also handles family law, wills and estate planning. Its website separately advertises a free 20-minute appointment.[3][8] |
| **Barton Family Lawyers** | Chermside; also serves North Lakes | Fixed fees for family-law services, including consent orders, plus a reduced-rate initial consultation.[4][10] |
| **Bloom Law** | Brisbane Northside | A complimentary 15-minute call, or a 60-minute initial consultation for $440; fixed-fee family-law options are available. Eligible clients may use JustFund, with repayment deferred until settlement.[1] |
| **Preston & Associates** | North Lakes | Fixed-fee wills and estate planning; a standard will starts from $880, with separate fixed-fee pricing for enduring powers of attorney and more complex wills.[2] |
| **Koolik & Associates Lawyers** | North Lakes and Aspley | Free 15-minute discovery call and fixed-fee services covering family law, wills and estates, and conveyancing.[5] |
| **R&G Law Group** | Brisbane, not Chermside/North Lakes | Free 15-minute appointments for Queensland residents regarding family law, wills and estates; wills start from $880, and payment plans are available for eligible matters.[9] |

**Best local matches by need:**

- **Free first contact:** Northside Family Law Centre, Bloom Law, or Koolik & Associates.[1][5][8]
- **Fixed-fee family law:** Barton Family Lawyers or Bloom Law.[1][4]
- **Fixed-fee wills:** Preston & Associates in North Lakes; R&G Law Group also publishes will prices but is outside the requested suburbs.[2][9]
- **Deferred or staged payment:** Bloom Law’s JustFund arrangement is the clearest advertised deferred-fee option; R&G Law Group advertises payment plans rather than settlement-based deferral.[1][9]

Confirm the current fee, eligibility criteria, and whether the consultation is legal advice or only an introductory call before booking.
